verified.notes: Packed tarball 0.1.0 (sha256 369bc4be6f5fd3be223982695249b629b9ec7ab1282c1d6b28806b0a3195a464) installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop web profile created from the shipped template (DSH 0.2.1-rc.5). dsh --profile <test> --dump-config composed the bundle row; a bounded real startup served the Web app; the authenticated browser transport exercised the exact /api/skillre-sticky-wall/execute route (list, create, update, archive, delete) and a second startup proved the note survived a restart through the storage domain. An unauthenticated request to the same route returned 401, so Connection still fences it. Cleanup stopped every owned process, removed the owned profile root and verified it was gone. The real DSH Web UI was then driven in headless Chromium against the same owned profile: the 便签墙 sidebar entry appeared and selected the panel, the wall mounted with the seeded welcome note, the composer created a blue note, pin moved it first, search filtered to it, archive hid it from the default wall, the archived toggle showed it again, the note survived a full page reload, and the dark theme re-styled every card. 15/15 UI assertions passed with no uncaught errors (docs/evidence/ui-verification.json plus four screenshots). Cleanup stopped every owned process, removed the owned profile and Chromium scratch directories and verified both were gone.

observations.install: packed tarball installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop DSH web profile

evidence.artifact-envelope: tests/client-bundle.spec.ts loads lib/client.js through window.__ModuleLoader__.load and asserts one registration, only the seeded react modules, the Cordis client contract and both slot registrations
evidence.host-contracts: tests/transport.spec.ts drives the exact Fetch route with real Request objects; tests/store.spec.ts covers the domain-backed store; tests/plugin.spec.ts covers config resolution and Fiber-scoped lifetime
evidence.packed-payload-bytes: scripts/verify-isolated.mjs checks every required packed file exists in the installed package under the owned profile root

observations.pendingDetail: Verified in the standalone DSH Web application. The Desktop Client (Electron) was not exercised: its profile is managed by the application and cannot be driven by this CLI-based harness. A Desktop-targeted release must repeat the visual check there.
